transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As part of our normal prepayment review for the proposed $8,000,000 voluntary loan prepayment this quarter, I need to check with each of you before I make the binding treasury decision. We have $18,000,000 in unrestricted cash, a $10,000,000 term loan at 7.2%, and a $5,000,000 interest-rate swap paired with it. I'd like to hear from lender relations, treasury forecasting, and tax accounting -- please share any information that could affect this transaction.

The email also confirms that this amount needs no loan-amendment filing. I should note I haven't uploaded this email to the transaction file yet, but it's directly relevant to our prepayment decision.

transcript.text: I completed the rolling cash forecast this morning, and it confirms that $7,250,000 of unrestricted cash must remain as the operating reserve through quarter-end due to scheduled payroll, tax, and supplier outflows. This forecast has not yet been circulated to Elena. With $18,000,000 in unrestricted cash and $7,250,000 needing to stay as operating reserve, we have $10,750,000 available for prepayment -- so the proposed $8,000,000 prepayment is feasible from a cash perspective, but it would leave only $2,750,000 in cushion above the reserve.
